rationale: The first reply correctly explained the yellow sooty flame as incomplete combustion, told the customer to stop using that burner, and limited DIY to cleaning and reseating the cap/crown (normal user maintenance, not gas parts), while the safety panel surfaced the gas-smell emergency procedure. However it did not directly ask about any gas smell or CO symptoms before offering a cleaning routine, which the ground truth says must be asked; the customer volunteered the smell themselves. Once the smell with knobs off was reported, the assistant immediately and correctly treated it as a gas escape with 'Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999', though the final turn was terse and did not reiterate the Gas Safe engineer follow-up or ask about CO symptoms. No fabrication, no parts, no looping.
